name: Frozen pruning methods on 512 fresh toy Module-LWE lattice groups
rule: Remove floor(fraction * nonzero ZZ terms) by ascending magnitude with lexicographic ties. Keep all fields, original normalization, encoding, objective and mixer. No new fitting or instance selection.
primary_quality_criterion: Retain at least 95% of the full fixed QAOA mean extra distance improvement over Babai at 1024 shots. Require the paired instance-bootstrap 2.5th percentile of the retention ratio to exceed 0.95 for each primary candidate. These are approximate one-sided 97.5% bounds (Bonferroni for the two prespecified primary candidates); report bounds even if the criterion fails.
secondary_metrics: Exact optimum success, standalone and with Babai
Mean returned distance and squared distance
Strict improvement and recovery conditional on Babai failures
Observed sampled outcomes and planted-secret recovery
cohort_policy: One example per fresh A modulo q. Assert all 512 matrices differ from each other and from all 64 development and 16 training matrices. Abort on overlap; never filter by outcomes, coverage, error, or difficulty. Keep box failures.
classical_controls: Uniform sampling in the identical box
CBD secret sampling with optimal public modular lift
sampling: Independent NumPy categorical draws from ideal statevector probabilities, checked against every compiled Qiskit/Aer circuit. Store 16384 draws per instance/method; smaller budgets use prefixes.
limitations: Independent examples from the SAME tiny parameter distribution, not larger lattices or secure ML-KEM.

Selected methods were developed on earlier data; all choices are frozen for this fresh evaluation. Reusing these outcomes to select further changes makes this cohort development data for those later changes.

Ideal probabilities are exact up to floating-point error. Instance bootstrap describes population uncertainty under this generator; shot prediction intervals describe measurement variability on the fixed cohort.
The 1024-shot primary comparison matches prior experiments; larger budgets and the trained 75% method are secondary. More shots do not improve single-shot probability or demonstrate scaling.
Retaining Babai guarantees no worsening relative to Babai, not superiority to full QAOA or classical refinement.
Classical CBD sampling uses the known secret distribution and is not confined to the QAOA box. Equal candidate counts are not equal runtime.
All-to-all compiled CX resources exclude device routing, noise and QPU duration. No hardware or quantum-advantage claim.
